transcription.notes: cc. 20r, 21r, 22v complete. 21 changes logged in retranscription_log_1570.tsv. Blind sample of 57 groups: 8.8% disagreement, all resolved on zoom, none against the solver. system.summary: Simple substitution by number, spaces kept: the alphabet numbered in fives with neighbouring pairs swapped; o usually 7, u/v 2; a few three-digit code groups.

diacritics.note: A stroke over a group doubles the letter (one use).

system.doubled_letters: written twice; one stroke over a group
system.notes: 10, 20, 40 and 45, 55, 85 and 3, 5 are close in this hand; a lone letter rests partly on sense. The fields above describe WAINUT's key.tsv (3 Nov 2026). kennedy_2026/key_kennedy.tsv (Matthew Kennedy, 21-23 Nov 2026) has the same letter values and adds 3 = z, a dot-marked 5 for b, and values for five codes (104 che, 159 per, 109 Duca, 182 V.E., 13 et). The two differ on the group between dan[n]o and interesse on c. 20r, 13 (et) for Kennedy and 15 (d) for WAINUT; neither is chosen (NOTES.md, Two keys, not chosen).

prior_solution.where: None found; one web search, 3 Nov 2026.

texts.label: Number passages, cc. 3v-23r (WAINUT, 3 Nov 2026; without the lower half of c. 4r)
texts.summary: Estate and grain business from a convent in Naples: the sequestration of San Paolo by Don Paolo Ruffo, and a request for licensed grain that she turned aside because the Camera held the licences for the State of Milan.
texts.note: Number words 198: as sense 172 (86.9%), no restored or changed letter 172 (86.9%), 17 doubtful, 9 not read.

reading_review.by: AI language-model agent (for WAINUT; a model reading, not a person), independent of the solver
reading_review.note: Read as sentences 3 Nov 2026. Most passages read as Italian sentences and match the English: the San Paolo sequestration by Paolo Ruffo, 'Per amor di Dio... fidarci di nessuno', c. 20r on the loading, and above all c. 21r on the Torre Maggiore grain licences held by the Camera for Milan. About a third of the sentences have holes, and they are clustered rather than scattered: c. 3v has several weak guesses (stcmo/sperate, seculnorio->sequestratore, spaltta->Spagna, banatte unread, 'Mog.' wives line muddled), c. 4r opens with 'lutti pollici nelli' and 'uocire' unread, c. 11r is a fragment that does not make sense, c. 22r and the last line of c. 23r ('preceti') are unclear, and two code groups ([109], [182]) are unidentified.

texts.label: Letter of 2 April 1686, cc. 3v-4r (Matthew Kennedy, 21-23 Nov 2026)
texts.summary: The two nuns to their brother: Don Paolo Ruffo means to lift the sequestration of San Paolo and they fear a sale of the goods; the Marquis of Casale Nuovo is seeking a writ of execution in the Vicaria; the only remedy is a safeguard from Spain; at the Collaterale no one can be trusted. Then praise of a young gentleman from Rome who has no crust of bread assigned to him, and his prayer for the birth of a little prince.
texts.note: Matthew Kennedy, PR #853 (21-23 Nov 2026), key kennedy_2026/key_kennedy.tsv. 155 cipher words, 14 holes by the strict count (kennedy_2026/NOTES.md; recounted by the review of the pull request). The clear text is in italics in the reading file.

reading_review.by: integration review of PR #853 (AI agent, for the maintainers); not a person
reading_review.note: Read as sentences with the English beside it, 24 Nov 2026: the number passages complete the clear sentences around them throughout (the sequestration, the safeguard of Spain, fidarci di nessuno, the gentleman of Rome). Two places do not read smoothly: 'ha tenut[o] V.E. di tal materia' on c. 3v, where the English supplies 'us unaware', and 's[i] presto senta la nascita' on c. 4r. Grade B: 13 words carry supplied letters. Codex's review of 22 Nov 2026 for the maintainers (kennedy_2026/NOTES.md) predates the literal decryption. No image opened.
